# AuthOnce

> Non-custodial USDC subscription payment protocol on Base Network. Subscribers authorize recurring payments with an EIP-2612 permit signature; funds move in a single atomic on-chain transfer directly from subscriber wallet to merchant wallet on each billing cycle. AuthOnce never holds or controls funds. Currently live on Base Sepolia testnet; mainnet launch targeted for Q3 2026, pending security audit.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://authonce.io/): product overview, pricing, fee calculator, founding merchant offer
- [Web3 integration docs](https://authonce.io/docs/web3): SubscriptionVault and MerchantRegistry contract integration
- [AI agent integration docs](https://authonce.io/docs/ai-agents): ERC-1271 smart-wallet and AI-agent subscription flows
- [Status](https://authonce.io/status): protocol status
- [Legal](https://authonce.io/legal), [Privacy](https://authonce.io/privacy), [Terms](https://authonce.io/terms)

## Blog

- [Blog](https://blog.authonce.io/): articles on non-custodial billing, EIP-2612 permits, programmable grace periods, and subscriptions on Base Network

## Notes

- Protocol fee: 0.5%, hardcoded on-chain in executePull(). No other fees.
- Not yet audited. Not yet deployed to mainnet as of August 2026.
